title: bioid wallet registry
description: Published list of holding wallets for one ecosystem that adopts the bioid recipe. The recipe repository defines this format and ships a synthetic example only. A real ecosystem publishes its own registry elsewhere and anchors the bytes from its contract metadata (TZIP-16 URI with a sha256 binding) and, preferably, Tezos Domains names that resolve to the same addresses. See docs/wallet-types.md. bioid-wallet-types-2 adds EXTERNAL_USER. A version 1 file that does not use that type still validates.

notice.description: Human-readable status of this file. The example in the recipe repository says that it is synthetic. A live registry identifies the ecosystem and where the file is published.

vocabulary.description: Wallet-type rulebook this file was written against. bioid-wallet-types-2 is the current docs/wallet-types.md. bioid-wallet-types-1 is the previous five-type vocabulary.

publication.description: Where a reader should fetch the authoritative bytes. The recipe example states that it is not a live registry.

anchor.description: How a live registry is anchored. Illustrative in the recipe example. Do not treat a placeholder hash as a commitment.

metadata_key.description: TZIP-16 requires a URI at the empty key of big_map %metadata string bytes.

uri_template.description: sha256://0x<64 hex digits>/<percent-encoded registry URI>, as specified by TZIP-16. The hash is of the published bytes and is not stored inside those bytes.

tez_domains.description: Names recorded on wallets SHOULD resolve to those wallet addresses once registered. Names in the recipe example are synthetic and are not registered.

address.description: Tezos implicit-account shape. The recipe example uses strings that match this shape and fail checksum validation, so they are not accounts.

type.description: Core vocabulary through bioid-wallet-types-2. EXTERNAL_USER is the approved recipient. Version 1 files use only the first five.

site.description: Campus or courier operation. Not a postal address and not coordinates.

parent_location.description: Address of the parent STORAGE wallet for a rack or box. Null for a top-level wallet.

custodian.description: Organisation whose signer keys may act. Not a person, and not the FA2 balance holder. The on-chain field custodian is this address.

tez_domain.description: SHOULD be set (principle 4). A readable Tezos Domains name. In a live registry it SHOULD resolve to address. In the recipe example it is a synthetic placeholder.

storage_temperature.description: MIABIS-SAMPLE-03 allowed values, copied from the public MIABIS sample component. Mapping of storage_kind itself to MIABIS is to be confirmed.

process_note.description: Required in practice when process is other. Free text stays off the transition rules.

expected_max_dwell.description: ISO 8601 duration, day and hour forms. Illustrative in the recipe example. Overrun alerts the monitor; it does not revert the operation.
